page.overview:
Who is Benicio Lorelei?

is a human blood hunter and a member of the Lorelei family. He was played by Sam Riegel in .

In his human form Benicio looks like a man of dark skin (although lighter than those of his two oldest siblings) with a soft purple hue (sign of his drow ancestry), dark eyes and short black hair with a streak of white. He has several scars on his face, with one going through his left eyebrow, and more scars and burns on his torso and arms. He wears green clothes, with vine patterns on some of his garments. Benicio has features in common with his brother Lawrence, but they are not identical twins: beyond the style and personal aesthetics of each one, the younger twin has a less pronounced jaw, and has scars that the older twin lacks; furthermore, they both have distinct white hair patterns.

In his werewolf form, Benicio is mostly covered in white fur on the right half of his body and black on the left. His arms get bigger, stronger and ropier, but they are mostly scar tissue and skin, lacking large areas of fur due to prior burning.

Benicio had an itch for danger from an early age. He jokes and plays pranks on his siblings.
